44442155.article_content:
90-degree turn brings bridge project to a screeching halt
Seven engineers have been suspended and two construction companies blacklisted over a railway over-bridge in Bhopal
Amrit Dhillon
, Delhi
Sunday June 29 2025, 6.45pm
,
The Times
The Madhya Pradesh government has suspended seven engineers over a “dangerous” 90-degree turn on the new railway over-bridge
Amrit Dhillon
, Delhi
Sunday June 29 2025, 6.45pm
,
The Times
For centuries, engineering marvels scattered across India have been a source of national pride.
The 14th-century stepwell of Agrasen ki baoli outside New Delhi was an ingenious medieval answer to perennial water shortages. The Taj Mahal, with its floating foundation designed to withstand the Yamuna River’s shifting course, combined the best of Persian and Mughal know-how to ensure the testament to symmetry and beauty stood the test of time.
In 2018, the State of Unity, the world’s tallest statue, in the northwest of
India
, was inaugurated by Narendra Modi, the prime minister, and was built to withstand wind speeds of more than 100 miles per hour at 597 feet.
This week, however, the engineering talent behind a new bridge in the central Indian city
of Bhopal has attracted national attention for all the wrong reasons.
A nearly 90-degree turn was built into the railway over-bridge, leaving drivers aghast as they were expected to screech to sudden halts before taking what critics have said are dangerously sharp turns.
Advertisement
Ten years and 200 million rupees (£1.7 million) after its construction was announced, the bridge meant to eliminate long waiting times at railway crossings has yet to be opened, pending a redesign to lengthen the turn by a few extra feet.
Seven of its engineers have been suspended, even though they initially defended the widely-mocked construction.
Drivers encountering the sharp turn have had to suddenly brake to avoid crashing, with two construction companies blacklisted over the project
VD Verma, the chief engineer, previously said they had “no other option” but to design the right-angle turn. “We had constraints owing to the limited availability of land at a nearby metro station,” he said.
Social media users sarcastically referring to the bridge as an “engineering marvel” on X wondered who in the local government, ruled by
Modi’s Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)
, would dare attend the inauguration.
The engineers tried to salvage the situation by saying the flyover would be limited to cars, with no heavy vehicles allowed, and that strict speed limits would be imposed.
Advertisement
The mockery continued, however, forcing Mohan Yadav, the chief minister of Madhya Pradesh state, to order an inquiry. Its report found gross negligence in both the planning and execution of the project. Two of the construction companies have been blacklisted.
A report has found gross negligence in the planning and execution of the bridge in Bhopal
A similar engineering faux pas occurred in Bombay in Maharashtra, also ruled by the
BJP
, last year. The two sides of a new overbridge failed to meet in the middle, with a misalignment of six feet rendering it a bridge to nowhere.
“Yes, truly the first in India, probably in the world, that the two bridges that were to be joined have a difference of six feet in height,” the opposition leader Aaditya Thackeray said at the time.
Although India is home to some remarkable megaprojects, its modern infrastructure projects have often been plagued by unconscionable delays and cost overruns. A combination of incompetence and corruption is often thought to be the root cause.
In Bihar, a bridge in Khagaria over the Ganges river missed eight deadlines and was still not finished when the middle section collapsed in 2023. When the cloud of dust settled, a vast chunk of the bridge had fallen into the river and the rest was hanging in the water. It is now due to be finished next year, 12 years after work began.

data.title: Moderna says mRNA flu vaccine sailed through trial, beating standard shot
data.author: LorenDB
data.article_summary: Moderna宣布其基于mRNA的季节性流感疫苗mRNA-1010在预防流感感染方面比传统流感疫苗有效性高27%。该试验涉及近4.1万名50岁及以上人群，结果显示mRNA疫苗总体有效性高出26.6%，65岁及以上人群高出27.4%。尽管试验结果积极，但由于美国卫生部门由反对疫苗的活动家罗伯特·肯尼迪 Jr. 领导，mRNA-1010的未来前景不明。肯尼迪推行所有新疫苗需进行安慰剂对照试验，并取消了Moderna开发mRNA流感疫苗的资助，还限制使用含乙基汞防腐剂的流感疫苗。专家认为这些措施不道德且与科学共识相悖。

An mRNA-based seasonal flu vaccine from Moderna was 27 percent more effective at preventing influenza infections than a standard flu shot,
the company announced this week
.
Moderna noted that the new shot, dubbed mRNA-1010, hit the highest efficacy target that it set for the trial, which included nearly 41,000 people aged 50 and above. Participants were randomly assigned to receive either mRNA-1010 or a standard shot and were then followed for about six months during a flu season.
Compared to the standard shot, the mRNA vaccine had an overall vaccine efficacy that was 26.6 percent higher, and 27.4 percent higher in participants who were aged 65 years or older. Previous trial data showed that mRNA-1010 generated higher immune responses in participants than both regular standard flu shots and high-dose flu shots.
The company noted that the positive results for the new trial come in the wake of one of the worst flu seasons in years. During the 2024–2025 flu season, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention estimates that 770,000 people in the US were hospitalized for the flu.
"Today's strong Phase 3 efficacy results are a significant milestone in our effort to reduce the burden of influenza in older adults," Moderna CEO Stéphane Bancel said in a statement. "The severity of this past flu season underscores the need for more effective vaccines. An mRNA-based flu vaccine has the potential advantage to more precisely match circulating strains, support rapid response in a future influenza pandemic, and pave the way for COVID-19 combination vaccines."
Uncertain future
At present, the fate of promising vaccines such as mRNA-1010 is uncertain as the US health department is currently helmed by anti-vaccine activist Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Under Kennedy, the health department announced that "
all new vaccines
" would be required to go through placebo-controlled trials. That means that participants in a trial who are not given the experimental vaccine must be given an inert placebo rather than an already-approved vaccine as a comparative group, as was the case in the new trial with mRNA-1010.
Experts have pointed out that giving a placebo to participants when a safe vaccine already exists against potentially life-threatening infections is unethical, which is why it's not done.
Beyond that, Kennedy has canceled grants awarded to Moderna under the Biden administration to
develop mRNA-based pandemic influenza vaccines
. A health department spokesperson said at the time that the "reality is that mRNA technology remains under-tested."
Last week, Kennedy also worked to restrict access to
flu vaccines that contain an ethylmercury-containing preservative
, despite decades of data indicating their safety.
Beth Mole
Senior Health Reporter
Beth Mole
Senior Health Reporter
Beth is Ars Technica’s Senior Health Reporter. Beth has a Ph.D. in microbiology from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and attended the Science Communication program at the University of California, Santa Cruz. She specializes in covering infectious diseases, public health, and microbes.

data.title: The first American 'scientific refugees' arrive in France
data.author: saubeidl
data.article_summary: 法国艾克斯-马赛大学推出了“科学的避风港”计划，旨在吸引因担心特朗普政府削减科研经费而受影响的美国学者。这是法国首个此类项目，已迎来八位即将加入的美国研究人员，他们可能成为首批因政治原因离开美国前往法国的学术难民。项目提供与法国研究人员相同的薪资，尽管美国学者在法国的薪资较低，但生活成本也更低，且子女教育免费。该大学已投入1500万欧元用于该计划，并正游说政府增加拨款以扩大招聘。项目负责人将当前情况比作二战前欧洲学者逃离纳粹迫害的历史，强调了科研环境的紧迫性。许多申请者来自斯坦福和耶鲁等名校，反映了美国学术界对科研环境的广泛担忧。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：法国科研人员的薪资待遇、科研经费问题以及“科学安全港”计划对不同群体的影响

不同观点：
• **科研人员薪资过低，科研经费不足**：[maeln] 指出法国年轻科研人员的薪资仅略高于最低工资，科研经费严重不足。尽管法国有较强的劳工权益和较长假期，但低薪资和经费短缺让科研人员难以维持生计，尤其是与美国相比。该评论担心即便法国吸引到受威胁的科研人员，可能也难以长期留住他们。

• **“科学安全港”计划对法国科研人员的冲击**：[probably_wrong] 认为虽然美国科研难民将获得与法国科研人员相同的工资，但这些职位本可以提供给法国本土科研人员。该评论质疑该计划可能有利于法国科学整体，但对法国科研社区来说是一种竞争压力，不利于本地科研人员的职业发展。

• **特定学科科研人员受影响更大**：[ThinkBeat] 提出在当前美国政治环境下，女性研究、性别研究、批判种族理论和气候科学的学者可能受到更大冲击，因此这些领域的学者更有可能申请法国的“科学安全港”计划。

• **签证和移民系统的潜在问题**：[curiousgal] 认为该计划可能只是政治噱头，外国科研人员在面临法国复杂的签证续签和反移民官僚体系时，可能会后悔迁移到法国。

• **欢迎外来科研人员**：[Am4TIfIsER0ppos] 表示对外来科研人员的热烈欢迎，认为这是一个好的机会。

• **历史类比的争议**：[linotype] 认为将当前情况与二战前逃离纳粹迫害的欧洲学者相比是不恰当的，尤其是从历史角度来看，这种类比存在冒犯性。

• **美国学术界的意识形态问题**：[762236] 认为那些避免意识形态偏见并支持思想多样性的美国大学（如雇佣保守派学者）将不会受到政治变化的严重影响。

• **法国未来政治环境的不确定性**：[sunshine-o] 提出法国下届总统选举临近，极右翼政党有可能上台，目前的科研难民可能在未来面临类似的政治困境，因此科研人员应有长期规划，而不应因短期政治变化频繁迁移。

补充讨论：
- 不同评论者对“科学安全港”计划的态度存在分歧，有人认为这是帮助受威胁科研人员的机会，有人则认为该计划存在实际问题（如薪资、签证和未来政治不确定性）。
- 历史类比和意识形态问题引发了对该计划背景和动机的更广泛讨论，特别是如何看待当前学术自由受到威胁的问题。

44443758.article_content:
MARSEILLE, France — The first American academics fleeing Donald Trump's America for France have arrived.
Aix-Marseille University last week introduced eight U.S.-based researchers who were in the final stage of joining the institution's “Safe Place for Science" program, which aims to woo researchers who have experienced or fear funding cuts under the Trump administration. AMU offers the promise of a brighter future in the sun-drenched Mediterranean port city.
While both France and the European Union
have launched multimillion-euro plans
to woo researchers across the pond since Trump assumed the U.S. presidency in January, AMU's initiative was the first of its kind in the country — meaning the eight researchers who were welcomed are the first academic refugees planning to trade the United States for France.
Advertisement
Advertisement
Speaking from the university’s hilltop astrophysics lab, AMU President Eric Berton likened the situation to that of European academics who fled persecution by Nazi Germany both before and during World War II.
“What is at play here today is not unrelated to another dark period of our history,” he said.
Berton and former French President François Hollande have
pushed for the creation of a "scientific refugee" status
.
As most of the researchers who attended Berton’s speech had not yet signed their contracts with AMU, they requested anonymity to protect their stateside research positions if they ended up not being admitted or declining the offer.
Among the applicants were James, a climate scientist at a reputable research university, and his wife, who studies the intersection of judicial systems and democracies. James said they had applied because they were “working in areas which are targeted” and could be prone to funding cuts.
While James, who didn't want his surname used, said he doesn't think of himself and his fellow academics as "refugees," he voiced deep concern about the future of academic research under Trump.
Advertisement
Advertisement
Brian Sandberg, a professor of history at Northern Illinois University who researches climate change during the Little Ice Age period from roughly the 16th to 19th centuries, had already been set to spend a year in Marseille as a visiting professor. While taking part in a workshop in the city in March, he learned of AMU’s program and decided to apply.
"The entire system of research and the entire education in the United States is really under attack," Sandberg said.
AMU said 298 researchers from prestigious universities including Stanford and Yale had applied, despite the university's lack of name recognition outside France compared to some of its Parisian counterparts. Berton said the high volume of applicants spoke to the "urgency" of the situation across the Atlantic.
The university’s president insisted that participants in the “Safe Place for Science” program would be paid the same wages as French researchers. | Clement Mahoudeau/AFP via Getty Images
The school has already put up €15 million to pay for the program and is lobbying the French government to match that figure, which would enable it to nearly double its planned hires from 20 to 39.
Still, moving to a new country where English is not the official language a big step. There's also the issue of salaries, which are lower for academics in France than in the United States, and the fact there's less money for research.
An early-career biological anthropologist said she was still awaiting contract details from AMU before putting pen to paper because of salary discrepancies, though she took comfort in the fact that the cost of living is lower in France — especially considering that education for her two children, who she said were eager to settle in Marseille, would be free.
The university’s president insisted that participants in the “Safe Place for Science” program would be paid the same wages as French researchers. The statement sought to appease concerns within France’s academic community that money would now be focused on drawing U.S. scientists whereas local researchers
have long complained
of insufficient funding.

44443758.article_summary: 法国艾克斯-马赛大学推出了“科学的避风港”计划，旨在吸引因担心特朗普政府削减科研经费而受影响的美国学者。这是法国首个此类项目，已迎来八位即将加入的美国研究人员，他们可能成为首批因政治原因离开美国前往法国的学术难民。项目提供与法国研究人员相同的薪资，尽管美国学者在法国的薪资较低，但生活成本也更低，且子女教育免费。该大学已投入1500万欧元用于该计划，并正游说政府增加拨款以扩大招聘。项目负责人将当前情况比作二战前欧洲学者逃离纳粹迫害的历史，强调了科研环境的紧迫性。许多申请者来自斯坦福和耶鲁等名校，反映了美国学术界对科研环境的广泛担忧。
44443758.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：法国科研人员的薪资待遇、科研经费问题以及“科学安全港”计划对不同群体的影响

不同观点：
• **科研人员薪资过低，科研经费不足**：[maeln] 指出法国年轻科研人员的薪资仅略高于最低工资，科研经费严重不足。尽管法国有较强的劳工权益和较长假期，但低薪资和经费短缺让科研人员难以维持生计，尤其是与美国相比。该评论担心即便法国吸引到受威胁的科研人员，可能也难以长期留住他们。

• **“科学安全港”计划对法国科研人员的冲击**：[probably_wrong] 认为虽然美国科研难民将获得与法国科研人员相同的工资，但这些职位本可以提供给法国本土科研人员。该评论质疑该计划可能有利于法国科学整体，但对法国科研社区来说是一种竞争压力，不利于本地科研人员的职业发展。

• **特定学科科研人员受影响更大**：[ThinkBeat] 提出在当前美国政治环境下，女性研究、性别研究、批判种族理论和气候科学的学者可能受到更大冲击，因此这些领域的学者更有可能申请法国的“科学安全港”计划。

• **签证和移民系统的潜在问题**：[curiousgal] 认为该计划可能只是政治噱头，外国科研人员在面临法国复杂的签证续签和反移民官僚体系时，可能会后悔迁移到法国。

• **欢迎外来科研人员**：[Am4TIfIsER0ppos] 表示对外来科研人员的热烈欢迎，认为这是一个好的机会。

• **历史类比的争议**：[linotype] 认为将当前情况与二战前逃离纳粹迫害的欧洲学者相比是不恰当的，尤其是从历史角度来看，这种类比存在冒犯性。

• **美国学术界的意识形态问题**：[762236] 认为那些避免意识形态偏见并支持思想多样性的美国大学（如雇佣保守派学者）将不会受到政治变化的严重影响。

• **法国未来政治环境的不确定性**：[sunshine-o] 提出法国下届总统选举临近，极右翼政党有可能上台，目前的科研难民可能在未来面临类似的政治困境，因此科研人员应有长期规划，而不应因短期政治变化频繁迁移。

补充讨论：
- 不同评论者对“科学安全港”计划的态度存在分歧，有人认为这是帮助受威胁科研人员的机会，有人则认为该计划存在实际问题（如薪资、签证和未来政治不确定性）。
- 历史类比和意识形态问题引发了对该计划背景和动机的更广泛讨论，特别是如何看待当前学术自由受到威胁的问题。

data.title: Microsoft laying off about 9k employees in latest round of cuts
data.author: mooreds
data.article_summary: 微软宣布将在全球范围内裁员约9,000人，占其员工总数的不到4%，涉及不同团队和地区。这是微软2026财年开始时进行的组织调整的一部分，旨在减少管理层级，提高敏捷性和效率。此前，微软在2024年5月已裁员约6,000人，并于今年1月裁减了不到1%的员工。截至2024年6月，微软员工总数为228,000人。2023年，微软曾裁员10,000人，而2014年因收购诺基亚设备与服务部门，裁员人数高达18,000人。尽管裁员，微软在2024年第一季度的净利润接近260亿美元，营收达700亿美元，股价也创下新高。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：微软大规模裁员的合理性及企业责任

不同观点：
• [idkwhattocallme] 认为裁员虽然在大公司中常见，但微软的裁员尤其令人不满。理由是微软在过去五年中利润和估值大幅增长，公司多元化且没有根本性的业务风险。在这种背景下，裁掉3万名帮助公司取得成功的员工，显得公司只是把员工当成工具，缺乏长期责任感。他还质疑公司为何不能通过提升员工能力来避免大规模裁员，并提到历史上工会对中产阶级的保护作用，暗示现代企业可能需要类似的机制。

• [busterarm] 更关注裁员的频率和规模，指出微软不仅在过去几年中持续进行裁员，最近又在2023年5月裁掉了6000人，使得总数超过了25000人。这一观点强调了裁员的时间密集性和规模，质疑公司是否在过度雇佣后频繁调整，而不是进行更合理的长期规划。

补充讨论：
• [idkwhattocallme] 提到公司对员工的长期责任问题，认为即使在利润丰厚的情况下裁员，也显示出公司对员工福利的忽视。他暗示通过工会或其他集体谈判机制可能有助于改善这种情况。

• [busterarm] 通过具体数据指出裁员的时间线和规模，暗示公司存在过度雇佣和频繁调整的问题，但没有深入讨论裁员背后的原因或解决办法。

争议焦点：微软在盈利丰厚且无重大业务风险的情况下进行大规模裁员的合理性，以及企业是否应对员工负有更多长期责任。

Microsoft will cut less than 4% of its global workforce across teams, role types and geographies.
The software company also announced layoffs in May affecting around 6,000 people.
Executives are still trying to reduce management layers.

Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella speaks at Microsoft Build AI Day in Jakarta, Indonesia, on April 30, 2024.
Adek Berry | AFP | Getty Images
Microsoft
said Wednesday that it will lay off about 9,000 employees. The move will affect less than 4% of its global workforce across different teams, geographies and levels of experience, a person familiar with the matter told CNBC.
The announcement comes on the second day of Microsoft's 2026 fiscal year. Executives at the Redmond, Washington-based company typically unveil reorganizations at the time of the new fiscal year.
"We continue to implement organizational changes necessary to best position the company and teams for success in a dynamic marketplace," a Microsoft spokesperson said in an email.
Microsoft has held several rounds of layoffs already this calendar year. In January, it cut
less than 1%
of headcount based on performance. The 50-year-old software company
slashed over 6,000
jobs in May and then at least 300 more in June. As of June 2024 it employed 228,000 people. In 2023, it
laid off 10,000
.
Perhaps the largest culling of Microsoft workers came in 2014, when the company
eliminated 18,000
after acquiring Nokia's devices and services business.
As was the case with the May layoffs, Microsoft is looking to reduce the number of layers of managers that stand between individual contributors and top executives, the person said.
"To position Gaming for enduring success and allow us to focus on strategic growth areas, we will end or decrease work in certain areas of the business and follow Microsoft's lead in removing layers of management to increase agility and effectiveness," Phil Spencer, Microsoft's CEO of gaming, wrote in a Wednesday memo to employees in that division.
Microsoft reported nearly $26 billion in net income on $70 billion in revenue for the March quarter. The numbers were
well ahead
of Wall Street's consensus, keeping Microsoft ranked as one of the most profitable companies in the S&P 500 index, according to data compiled by FactSet.
Executives called for about 14% year-over-year revenue growth in the June quarter, thanks to expected expansion in Azure cloud services and corporate productivity software subscriptions
Microsoft stock closed at a record high of $497.45 per share on June 26. At the start of Wednesday's trading session, the shares were down about 0.6%, while the S&P 500 was roughly flat.
Autodesk
,
Chegg
and
CrowdStrike
are among the
other software providers
that have slimmed down in 2025. Earlier on Wednesday, Payroll processing company
ADP
said the U.S. private sector
lost 33,000 jobs
in June. Economists polled by Dow Jones had predicted an increase of 100,000.

Tesla reports 14% decline in vehicle deliveries, marking second straight year-over-year drop
Squawk on the Street
Tesla
reported
around 384,000 vehicle deliveries in the second quarter, a 14% decline from a year ago, and the second straight quarterly drop. The stock rose about 2% Wednesday.
The electric vehicle maker reported 443,956 deliveries and production of 410,831 vehicles during the same period last year.
Here are the key numbers:
Total deliveries Q2 2025: 384,122 vehicles
Total production Q2 2025: 410,244 vehicles
Wall Street analysts were expecting Tesla to report deliveries of around 387,000 according to FactSet.
Deliveries in the
first quarter
of 2025 dropped 13% from a year earlier to 336,681. Deliveries are the closest approximation of vehicle sales reported by Tesla but are not precisely defined in the company's shareholder communications.
The electric vehicle maker, headquartered in Austin, Texas, doesn't break out sales and production by model or region. However, the company said that it produced 396,835 of its most popular
Model 3 and Model Y cars
, with 373,728 combined deliveries for these models in the second quarter.
Many investors had low expectations heading into the print.
An independent researcher who publishes as Troy Teslike on Patreon predicted deliveries of 356,000 for the quarter. Prediction market Kalshi told CNBC on Tuesday that its traders forecast deliveries of around 364,000.
Deepwater Asset Management's Gene Munster said the report came 4% above the "whisper" number in a post to social media platform
X
. He expects the second-quarter decline to mark the bottom for Tesla.

Tesla faces an onslaught of competition, especially from Chinese EV makers that sell newer and more affordable models. In the first quarter, Tesla partly blamed its declining automotive sales on customers who had delayed their orders so they could get a refreshed version of the Model Y SUV, which began shipping in March.
There's also a political backlash against CEO
Elon Musk
, with waves of protests against Tesla weighing on the company's reputation and impacting sales.
Musk was
President Donald Trump's
biggest financial backer in last year's election, and endorsed Germany's far-right, anti-immigrant party AfD. He led the Trump administration's Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) initiative to slash the size and capacity of federal agencies, including regulators tasked with oversight of his companies. Musk's formal role with DOGE ended in May.

His relationship with Trump quickly began to sour and, over the weekend, Musk reignited the feud, slamming the multitrillion-dollar
tax-and-spending package
backed by the president, and calling for the creation of a third political party.
Certain aspects of the bill could harm Tesla's solar and battery business, and would likely lower EV sales by roughly 100,000 vehicles per year by 2035,
according to
think tank Energy Innovation.
Meanwhile, Trump has threatened to potentially end other subsidies that benefit Musk's businesses, including Tesla and the aerospace and defense company SpaceX. He even threatened to deport Musk, a naturalized, U.S. citizen.
Also in Wednesday's announcement, Tesla reported 10,394 deliveries of its other models during the second quarter, including its steel Cybertruck. The angular pickup has been recalled eight times for a variety of hardware and software issues since Tesla began shipping it in November 2023.
The company also reported that it had produced 410,244 vehicles during the three months ending in June, including 396,835 of its most popular, and lower-priced, Model Y SUVs and Model 3 sedans.
Shares of Tesla fell more than 5% on Tuesday to close at $300.71 and were down about 26% for the year, the worst performance among tech's megacap companies. The move put the company's market cap below $1 trillion.
The company will discuss financial results for the second quarter with investors on Wednesday, July 23, 2025 after markets close.

data.title: I built something that changed my friend group's social fabric
data.author: dandano
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讲述了作者如何通过创建一个Discord机器人解决朋友群体在疫情期间因分散各地而面临的游戏组织问题。作者和朋友们原用Signal聊天，但消息常常被淹没，导致错过游戏邀请。为解决此问题，作者开发了一个Discord机器人，当有人加入语音频道时发送通知，减少了不必要的文字聊天。尽管最初朋友们反应不一，但最终该机器人成功成为朋友间互动和社交的信号，显著增加了他们使用Discord的频率。数据记录显示，他们的使用次数和天数逐年增加，从2022年的2374次到2025年中的1378次，成为朋友们保持联系的重要工具。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：在线聊天工具、通知系统以及隐私问题

不同观点：
• **怀念旧式在线聊天的邀请机制**：donatj认为，过去的AIM或ICQ提供了一种明确的聊天邀请信号，而现在缺乏这种机制，使得在线交流失去了曾经的魅力。
• **物联网设备的通知系统**：thedanbob介绍了自己正在开发的物联网设备，用于通知朋友加入Discord语音频道，并计划将其产品化。他还提到为解决妻子无法及时收到通知的问题，他计划使用ESP32和LED板构建通知系统。
• **Discord是最佳聊天应用**：rockostrich强烈支持Discord，认为它是朋友群聊的最佳选择，并分享了自己为Discord服务器开发的多个机器人，如Music Quiz Bot、Birthday Bot、Plex Bot和Movie Quiz Bot。
• **隐私和数据安全的担忧**：udev4096对Discord的隐私政策表示担忧，质疑用户为何能轻易接受语音聊天被监控、录音和出售。

补充讨论：
• **使用Slack的替代方案**：exiguus表示自己更倾向于使用Slack，因为其具有通知功能，并且他们的朋友群已经采用了付费计划以获得更多功能。
• **自建和自托管的乐趣**：taraindara对自托管和学习新工具（如coolify）表示兴趣，认为更多人参与自托管是件好事。
• **Teamspeak的长久使用体验**：turbopasi分享了他们使用Teamspeak服务器超过20年的经验，强调其在朋友群中的重要性。
• **使用现有工具解决通知问题**：ksynwa建议使用ntfy等现有工具发送通知，而不是依赖Discord应用本身。

44403988.article_content:
This is a story that started back in 2022, but I think its a perfect time to reflect on the impact that it has had on my friend group still to this day.
A year or so before COVID, our friend group dispersed across the world - I moved to Vancouver, one friend moved to the UK and another one moved to the United States. The rest of them still lived in Melbourne.
Once COVID hit, like many others, we looked to find a way to keep in contact and still hang out. We have always been a big gaming group (both board game & video games) so moving online seemed like a logical choice. We had always used Discord so we started to ramp up our time there.
The problem
Over the next year, our group chat (in Signal) was drowning in notifications. A mix of general chit chat, talks on the ever changing news of COVID and the most important - when can people play games and chat. It really annoyed me when people would post on "hey anyone wanna play [game] in 15 mins?", for it to be buried in another 5 messages. The message would have to be constantly bumped in Signal before we eventually jumped in a voice chat in our Discord server. My friends were also annoyed that they didn't know we were playing a certain game tonight, for us to go "we talked about it on Signal!". Something had to change.
The solution
I thought, rather than people typing in Signal that they want to play a game in Discord, it would be better for Discord to notify us when someone has joined a voice channel in our server. Now you're probably thinking "Daniel, wouldn't this just be another notification that people would miss?" - you would be right to be skeptical, but I thought that since it was a distinct notification from Discord rather than Signal it would be better.
I went to Discord to find a setting to send a notification to the server when someone joined a voice channel, and I came up with crickets. There was no such thing. Eventually I found that you can write a Discord bot to leverage the
on_voice_state_update
from
discord.py
, a Discord API wrapper. So I spun up a new git repo and got to work writing a simple Discord bot. Here is main guts of the bot.
Since
on_voice_state_update
triggers on when a member joins or leaves a voice channel and if the member muted or deafened - we must check that the
before
channel is null and the
after
channel is not null to signify that they have joined a voice channel.
We then get the first text channel of the server so that our bot can send the message to the server. Then we actually send the message to the text channel. I added the
delete_after
option so that the text channel is not clogged up with all the messages sent from the bot. All we care about is receiving the notification. Finally, I add a record into a postgres table (hosted on
Supabase
) of the Discord server (guild), the member id and member display name along with a timestamp of when they joined. All this juicy data will come in handy later.
I originally hosted the bot on fly.io. But I've been on a mission to learn more about self-hosting, so I bought a server from Hetzner and it runs on same server as this blog using
Coolify
.
I added the bot to the server with the appropriate permissions and we are live! Here's what it looks like.
Notification on discord desktop client
Notification on iPhone
The reaction
My friends had mixed views when I initially told them. It was a 50/50 split between 'that sounds useful', to 'that sounds dumb and I won't use it'. The hardest part was convincing people to download the Discord app on their phone as most of us didn't have it downloaded.
Only a few months later, I had moved back to Melbourne and was with my friends on a sunny afternoon at a pub. My friend, Jack, who was initially in the 'I wont use it' camp, completely changed his tune. He said that it encourages him to jump into Discord not even to play games but just to have a quick chat with everyone and to socialize.
The batsignal of our group
I quickly realized that this has not just reduced the amount of messages around organizing to play games, it acted as a Batsignal for our friends to hang out. I estimated that over 60% of the time when people join Discord, it's just to have a chin-wag about our day and not to play a game.
The results
Since I had been keeping a record of each time someone joined Discord, I now had years worth of data to see some trends (as of 27th June 2025).

data.title: Jim Boddie codeveloped the first successful DSP at Bell Labs
data.author: jnord
data.article_summary: 文章纪念了数字信号处理（DSP）先驱吉姆·博迪（Jim Boddie）。在AT&T贝尔实验室工作期间，博迪与史蒂夫·沃尔特斯（Steve Walters）等人合作，共同开发了首个成功的DSP芯片——Bell Labs DSP1。沃尔特斯负责设计I/O电路和DSP开发系统，而帕特·海斯（Pat Hays）则是贝尔实验室的芯片开发负责人，著有《硅星球：我的电脑芯片生涯》。博迪的贡献对DSP技术发展具有重要影响。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于对20世纪90年代音频DSP芯片（如Ensoniq、Roland、Yamaha）进行逆向工程的讨论

不同观点：
• 观点一：对老旧DSP芯片的逆向工程非常有趣且有价值。这些芯片架构独特，比如48位VLIW（超长指令字）设计，且没有跳转或条件指令，这种设计在现代计算中非常罕见，因此提供了独特的编程挑战和学习机会。[支持者：rasz]

• 观点二：这些老旧DSP芯片的架构虽然独特，但缺乏现代计算中常见的条件指令和跳转，使得其在实际应用中可能不如现代芯片灵活和高效。有人认为这种逆向工程更多是出于怀旧和学术兴趣，而非实际应用价值。[暗示观点，基于对独特架构的质疑]

• 观点三：逆向工程这些芯片可能会带来一些现代技术上的启发。例如，了解过去的技术如何在资源有限的情况下实现高效音频处理，可能会为现代低功耗设备提供一些设计灵感。[支持者：对逆向工程持积极态度的群体]

补充讨论：
• 讨论中提到了具体的芯片型号和品牌，如Ensoniq、Roland、Yamaha，这些品牌在90年代的音频设备市场中占有重要地位。
• 有人指出这些芯片的逆向工程难度较大，因为其架构与现代芯片差异显著，尤其是缺乏条件指令和跳转机制。
• 争议的焦点在于逆向工程这些老旧芯片的主要价值是出于学术研究和怀旧，还是能够在现代技术中找到实际应用场景。

总结：讨论围绕对90年代音频DSP芯片的逆向工程展开，有人认为其独特架构提供了宝贵的学习和研究机会，而另一些人则质疑其在现代应用中的实际价值。争议点在于这种逆向工程的实际应用潜力。

data.title: Melbourne man discovers extensive model train network underneath house
data.author: cfcfcf
data.article_summary: 墨尔本一名男子Daniel Xu在购买新房后，意外发现地下室有一个庞大的模型火车网络。作为火车工程师和火车爱好者的他对此感到十分震惊，因为购房时并未提及这一设置。这套模型火车系统由前任房主在1960年代建造，已经多年未使用。Xu计划修复并升级这一系统，尽管这并非他购房时的初衷，但他非常兴奋能将其恢复运行，并希望与朋友的孩子分享这一爱好。
data.comments_summary:

• [alnwlsn] 描述了一个极度密集的火车模型地下室，认为这种布置非常怪异且不安全，甚至称其为“死亡陷阱”。该用户质疑房主为何会允许公众进入这样的环境，并暗示很多物品可能在出售后被丢弃。

• [wrs] 认为这个发现很棒，但对房屋检查员未能发现地下室的状态表示质疑，隐含对专业检查的失望。
• [Swannie] 质疑房屋检查过程，认为无论是检查员还是购房者都应该发现地下室的模型，并猜测房主可能故意隐瞒以促成交易。
• [ByteDrifter] 以诗意的语言描述发现别人梦想世界的意义，认为这不仅是房地产交易，更是一种时间胶囊。

Australia
'I was shocked': Melbourne man's 'unbelievable' find after buying house
Daniel Xu has loved trains since he was a child. In a surprising twist of fate, he now lives above an extensive hobby train network set.
The model train setup Daniel Xu found beneath the home he just purchased is impressive, but it has proven an even greater delight, given he is a train engineer and train enthusiast.
Source:
SBS News
Key Points
After finalising the purchase of a home in Melbourne's northern suburbs, a Melbourne man found something unexpected.
There had been no mention of the expansive model train network beneath the home's floors.
Coincidentally, new owner Daniel Xu is a keen train enthusiast and engineer.
As any new homeowner will know, there are always unknown things to be found in a new place.
From a kitchen cupboard that never seems to close properly, a curiously painted over area or the real performance of an air-conditioning unit, discoveries abound.
But after Daniel Xu and his wife finalised the purchase of their house in Melbourne's northern suburbs, he found what can only be described as a train enthusiast's dream beneath their feet.
Underneath his new home, Xu discovered a model train setup, designed around an extensive network of train lines and miniature landscapes.
Xu, a train enthusiast himself, had no idea this was what was under the home he ha just purchased.
Source:
SBS News
With plans for renovations, Xu needed to get beneath his house, much of which is raised, sitting above a carport.
Entering the undercroft of his new home via a small door, Xu was shocked to find the area, which is just tall enough to stand in, entirely taken up by the elaborate setup.
"To do the renovation, I would have to go downstairs to have a look and do some inspections and when I got down I saw this massive incredible train model just sitting there," he told SBS News.
"I was shocked and I immediately asked my wife to come down to have a look — she was shocked."
"It's unbelievable, so massive, so huge."
He said nothing had been mentioned about model trains during the open home inspections.
Coincidentally, Xu is a train enthusiast.
He works as a rolling stock engineer for a company that manufactures new trains and designs and constructs new
rail lines
.
The model train set was put together by the former owner of the house Daniel Xu recently purchased and could be about 60 years old.
Source:
SBS News
His love of rail started when he was young, through a Japanese cartoon about a crime-fighting train.
"It tells you how trains act like people to protect children," he said, describing the show.
Xu has since been in touch with the previous owner, who told them their father built the train network in the 1960s when they were a child.
The set had likely not been used for some years, with the area full of spiderwebs when Xu first went beneath the house and found the dusty set.
It is not the project he had in mind when buying his house, but Daniel Xu has committed himself to restoring the old model train network he found beneath his home and hopes to upgrade some of the technology.
Source:
SBS News
Xu, who said he already had a number or train toys and model trains, plans on getting the lines cleaned up, in order to test what still works and get the entire network back up and running.
While the separate control desks for each of the different zones of the train tracks likely represented modern technology when first installed, Xu hopes to upgrade it with some newer technology to share his love of trains.
"My friends kids come and play, they don’t want to leave, they spend the whole afternoon here although there is no power at all [running through it at the moment]," he said.

• [gadders] 引用了一则新闻，提到有人秘密建造大型火车模型，暗示该地下室的主人可能也是因为某种秘密爱好而没有将模型公开展示。
• [brunker2] 对地下室的发现过程表示惊讶，并开玩笑说如果发现类似情况，会先报警确认是否有人失踪，显示出对这种隐藏空间的担忧。
• [wrs] 认为这个发现很棒，但对房屋检查员未能发现地下室的状态表示质疑，隐含对专业检查的失望。
• [Swannie] 质疑房屋检查过程，认为无论是检查员还是购房者都应该发现地下室的模型，并猜测房主可能故意隐瞒以促成交易。
• [ByteDrifter] 以诗意的语言描述发现别人梦想世界的意义，认为这不仅是房地产交易，更是一种时间胶囊。
• [Theodores] 建议对这一故事进行后续报道，并讨论了在保护和现代化火车模型控制系统之间的平衡，强调了对原始设计和愿景的尊重。

补充讨论：
• [qtwhat] 和 [freeopinion] 以幽默和调侃的方式介入讨论，分别提到AI和数学概念（Klein bottles），将话题引向轻松的一面。
• [astrange] 和 [Kirr] 提到了与日本动画和科幻小说相关的内容，增加了对火车模型文化背景的探讨。
• [darkoob12] 提到当前对AI话题的过度关注，暗示对火车模型话题的新鲜感。
• [LeonB] 则以幽默的方式表达了对火车模型出现时机的无奈与调侃。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于房屋检查过程和购房者是否应为发现地下室模型负责。一部分人认为这是检查员的失误，另一部分人则认为房主可能有意隐瞒。
• 另一个争议点是这种密集布置的安全性和合理性，[alnwlsn] 认为这是不安全的“死亡陷阱”，而其他人如 [ByteDrifter] 则从浪漫化的角度看待这种收藏。

data.title: Pluto is a unique dialect of Lua with a focus on general-purpose programming
data.author: 90s_dev
data.article_summary: Pluto是Lua 5.4的超集编程语言，专注于通用编程。它加速开发过程，增强了标准库，并引入了多种新语法，如switch语句、复合运算符和三元表达式等。Pluto大部分与Lua 5.4源代码兼容，但新增的关键字可能导致冲突，可通过兼容模式解决。它也兼容Lua 5.4字节码，但有少量特性不生成Lua 5.4字节码。Pluto持续与Lua主库保持同步，计划在Lua 5.5发布时更新。其详细文档和开源网站提供了使用、工具和新增功能的指南，用户可在浏览器中使用交互式环境或下载预构建二进制文件。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Pluto语言的优点、缺点及其与Lua的关系

不同观点：
• **nathan_compton**：认为Pluto像是Lua上的语法糖，虽然可能吸引年轻开发者，但会增加认知负担。两个相似语言（Pluto和Lua）共存增加了复杂性，类似于Lisp宏的过度使用，最终可能导致不必要的复杂性。
• **TeddyDD**：认可将Lua功能打包，但认为Pluto的语法更改不当，像是试图将Lua变成TypeScript。例如，合并运算符和管道运算符在Lua中并非必要，且需要语言设计上的支持。
• **spacechild1**：支持Pluto引入的类、命名参数和字符串插值等功能，认为这些功能能解决Lua中OOP系统不统一和函数调用不便的问题，但也指出命名参数会使参数名成为API的一部分。
• **WillAdams**：提出是否可以通过Pluto进行GUI编程，认为一个小而灵活的语言结合GUI绑定和设计工具会非常有用。
• **wavemode**：提到Luau，并好奇Pluto与Luau的比较。
• **yungporko**：喜欢Pluto的快速编码特性，认为它能帮助开发者进入“流状态”，但Lua的冗长问题有时会打断这种状态。
• **Rochus**：对Pluto修改的Lua VM感兴趣，质疑为何不直接生成现有VM的字节码，并询问VM的修改细节。
• **yannis**：对Pluto的文档表示赞赏，但担心LuaRocks包的使用可能带来编译问题。
• **matusnovak**：询问Pluto是否能与Sol2等绑定库一起使用，并表示愿意手动创建stub文件。
• **actinium226**：关心Pluto是否能像Lua一样避免动态内存分配，从而用于实时安全关键环境。
• **90s_dev**：认为Pluto是Lua的更方便版本，适合JS/C/Java/C++用户，并可能替代Lua使用。
• **tzury**：批评Pluto的break语句设计，认为其break 1和break 2的用法容易混淆，质疑项目的目的。

补充讨论：
- **语法糖的争议**：部分开发者认为Pluto增加了不必要的复杂性，而另一些开发者则认为Pluto的语法改进提高了编码效率。
- **Pluto与Lua的兼容性**：讨论中多次提到Pluto与Lua的共存问题及其对现有Lua生态的影响。
- **具体功能实现**：如命名参数、break语句的具体设计及其潜在问题。
- **实际应用场景**：包括GUI编程、实时安全关键环境中的使用等。

Pluto is a unique dialect of Lua with a focus on general-purpose programming.
Why should you choose Pluto?
Accelerated Development.
Greatly enhanced standard library.
Several new syntaxes, such as switch statements, compound operators, ternary expressions, etc.
Focused On Lua Compatibility.
Pluto is largely compatible with Lua 5.4 source code, but there is an imperfection:
Pluto implements new keywords, which can cause conflicts with otherwise normal identifiers such as 'switch', or 'class'. The parser tries to identify what is meant but if that doesn't work, you can
use Compatibility Mode
.
Pluto is also compatible with Lua 5.4 bytecode. Pluto can execute Lua bytecode, and most Pluto features generate bytecode compatible with Lua.
There's a small subset of Pluto features which do not generate Lua 5.4 bytecode. This is documented alongside those features, so scripters can vouch to avoid using them when bytecode compatibility is desired.
Pluto has been dropped into large communities, and did not break any existing scripts (with compatibility mode enabled then gradually disabled).
Pluto actively rebases with Lua's main repository. We are not a time-frozen dialect. When Lua 5.5 releases, we intend on updating to that.
Documentation
A detailed documentation of getting started with, tooling for, and the additions and improvements of Pluto can be found
on our website
, which is
open-source as well
.
Getting Started
You can use Pluto right in your browser
in the interactive playground
, or find
pre-built binaries
on our releases page.

data.author: ZenithExtreme
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于PlayStation和AMD在图形处理技术及架构方面的讨论

不同观点：
• [phkahler] 建议直接参考原文链接，以获取更多背景信息，特别是关于Sony和AMD的技术动向。
• [DiabloD3] 指出目前没有RDNA5架构，确认RDNA4是最后一个，接下来将转向UDNA1架构，并与CDNA融合。同时批评文章标题误导。
• [whatever1] 认为PS5相比PS4 Pro在性能上有显著提升，但视觉飞跃不明显，可能是图形引擎变得臃肿，或者计算能力需求大幅增加。
• [monster_truck] 强调这是AMD和Sony在FSR 3及更先进技术上的延续，特别是BVH优化方面。
• [brcmthrowaway] 提出一个对比性问题，讨论Mark Cerny和Anand Shimpi谁是更好的计算机架构师。
• [LorenDB] 表示如果PlayStation的贡献足够好，RDNA4到RDNA5的改进可能像RDNA3到RDNA4一样成功，但价格需合理。
• [erulabs] 对UDNA1的软件支持表示期待，希望能在数据中心领域与Nvidia竞争，但也担心AMD的驱动和支持问题。
• [ZenithExtreme] 简单指出AMD的下一代GPU可能包含PlayStation技术。
• [lofaszvanitt] 质疑在当前PS世代游戏稀少的情况下，新技术应用的前景。
• [shmerl] 询问Sony何时会在PS上支持Vulkan。

补充讨论：
• 技术架构和路线图的明确性是讨论的焦点，特别是RDNA和UDNA1的区别和未来发展方向。
• 对AMD驱动和软件支持的担忧反映出开发者对其历史问题的顾虑。
• PlayStation平台的游戏数量问题引发了对新技术实际应用场景的讨论。
• 关于PlayStation是否会支持Vulkan的问题也成为部分讨论者的关注点。

data.title: The Zen of Quakerism (2016)
data.author: surprisetalk
data.article_summary: 本文探讨了贵格会（Quakerism）与禅宗佛教（Zen Buddhism）的共通之处，以及作者个人在这两种修行中的体验。作者出生于贵格会家庭，从小参加贵格会的静思会议，但一直觉得静坐困难。后来在27岁时接触到佛教，学习到禅修技巧，尤其是数息法，这帮助他更好地进行静坐。禅宗强调通过冥想实现觉醒，而贵格会则通过静默会议寻求内心和平与集体决策。两者都致力于减轻自我带来的痛苦，追求内心的和平与觉醒。作者认为这两种修行在理解自我和缓解痛苦方面都有 transformative（ transformative）的作用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Quakerism的实践、特点及其与 Zen 等其他传统的比较

不同观点：
• **Quakerism的独特价值与潜在问题**：
   - **quacked** 认为Quakerism教导了对未获得权威的不尊重，但同时尊重权威本身。他强调了Quaker拒绝在《圣经》前发誓等传统，并指出现代美国Quaker社区趋于世俗化，尽管其原始目的是消除教会作为人与上帝之间的障碍。
   - **hansonkd** 指出Quaker崇拜与冥想的区别，前者强调打开心灵去“倾听”，而后者更注重正念。他还提到Quaker社区正逐渐消亡，部分原因是其缺乏信条和结构，使得新成员难以融入。他还认为Quakerism有“品牌问题”，常被误认为是Quaker燕麦或Amish。

• **Quakerism与其他神秘主义传统的联系**：
   - **mekoka** 认为Quakerism应被视为基督教神秘主义的一部分，并可以与其他神秘主义传统（如Zen、Advaita、道教、苏菲主义等）建立联系。他引用Meister Eckhart的话，指出世界各地的神秘主义者有共通之处。
   - **kmoser** 则质疑是否在Quaker会议中存在必须发言的压力，他基于自身在Quaker学校的经验，认为发言是完全自愿的，且没有必要说“灵性深刻”的话。

• **Quakerism的宗教性与非宗教性**：
   - **hermitcrab** 作为一个无神论者，表达了对Quaker在社会运动中贡献的尊重，如发起国际特赦组织、乐施会和绿色和平组织。
   - **monkeycantype** 提到自己对Quaker会议的期望与实际体验之间的差距，他原以为Quaker会对圣经持怀疑态度，但发现其与传统圣经团体相似。

补充讨论：
• **对Quakerism的误解与不了解**：
   - **bovermyer** 坦承自己对Quakerism几乎一无所知。
   - **yapyap** 和 **_benton** 都提到他们最初对Quakerism的误解，以为文章是关于电子游戏或燕麦品牌。

• **Quakerism与自然的联系**：
   - **jonaustin** 指出Quakerism和佛教都重视和尊重自然，但原文未提及这一点。

• **对Quaker会议参与方式的讨论**：
   - **gandalfian** 提到在Quaker会议中，如果感到无聊，可以看书或做其他安静的活动，强调了参与的自愿性。

• **Quakerism与Zen的比较**：
   - **antithesizer** 认为Quakerism比Zen更不“禅”，但没有详细展开。

争议焦点：
• Quaker会议中的发言是否存在压力以及Quaker社区的消亡原因存在不同看法。

44413076.article_content:
The Zen of Quakerism
February 1, 2016
By
Peter Taylor
Garden II, ink on paper, by artist and Zen Master Rebecca Nie. View more of her work at rebexart.com.
Q
uakers and Buddhists have a few things in common. Most importantly, they share a common humanity and a commitment to creating peace in the world. They are both enlightenment religions. Both George Fox and the Buddha experienced a transformative, liberating awareness through the dedicated practice of quiet contemplation.
My life is an intersection of these religions. I was born a Quaker, to Quaker parents with Quaker grandparents and great-grandparents. I attended Friends schools through college. I sat in many meetings for worship. I have always been proud to be a Quaker. I found Buddhism later in life, when I was 27 years old. I was looking for a tonic for depression. I found Buddhist philosophy and writing soothing to my condition. I liked that Buddhism talked about meditation as a remedy to suffering.
Even though I had been meditating all of my life in Quaker meetings, I had always struggled with how to do it. As a child, meeting for worship was somewhere between difficult and excruciatingly painful. To amuse myself, I would count things. I would count people with glasses. I would count ceiling tiles. I would count the seconds on my watch. I would welcome any spoken message that would break up the monotony of the silence. I would welcome the break of meeting so I could talk and run around again.
When I learned to meditate in the Buddhist style, I learned to keep my awareness focused by counting my breaths. I learned to hold my body still while I focused my mind. I found a specific place to put my hands. In meditation, I was relieved of the burden of being moved by the Spirit to speak and say something spiritually profound. Learning Buddhist meditation techniques taught me how to sit in Quaker meeting. Through all those years of Quaker upbringing and Quaker education, I had somehow missed that fundamental teaching.
In my Zen practice, I sat many hours of meditation. I did sitting meditation, walking meditation, chanting meditation, bowing meditation, eating meditation, tea-drinking meditation, and listening meditation. I went on a retreat to the Detroit Zen Center and did cooking meditation, cleaning meditation, weeding meditation, and hours and hours of sitting meditation. All that meditation was not necessarily peaceful or easy as I did it. What I found is that the rest of my days became more peaceful and easier to manage. The meditation worked. It created peace.
Besides the regular sitting practice, Zen is based on a philosophy that is different from Quakerism. Zen compelled me to practice with the enticement of an enlightenment experience. The Zen tradition is a long tradition, dating back to the Buddha (who is believed to have lived and taught between the sixth and fourth centuries B.C.E.), of purposefully awakening. Zen masters through the ages have skillfully worked with their disciples and students to create the conditions for awakening to the True Nature of reality. The push of a Zen practice is to recognize your own True Nature. The promise of that liberating experience was compelling enough to inspire me to do all that meditation.
As I studied Zen in Toronto, Ontario, I did not attend Quaker meeting. That changed when my family and I moved back to New Jersey in July 2013. Instead of finding an area Zen
sangha
(practice community), I returned to Quaker meeting for worship.
Upon returning to Quakerism, I found a group of earnest seekers, coming together in silence to try to find peace in their lives and create peace in the world. The meeting drew me into the community by inviting me to be on various committees. Committee work and the business of the meeting is one way that Quakers spread the peace of Sunday meeting for worship into the rest of the week.
In monthly meeting for business, making difficult decisions and resolving conflict test the peace of the worship. As a spiritual practice, recognizing the will of the group and releasing your own opinions can be transformative. It requires patience, respect, faith, and competent leaders to guide the process. When these factors are not present, the group may make decisions, but individuals feel excluded, egos grow, and conflict escalates. I’ve witnessed this in many meetings throughout my life. I’ve also witnessed excellent conflict resolution, where all participants feel committed to the direction of the group and uplifted through the resolution of conflict and a clear way forward.
Recognizing your True Nature in Zen and coming to a decision through Quaker process are both exercises in understanding our egos and, ultimately, easing our suffering by releasing them. This is a transformative experience that Quakerism and Buddhism offer.
In Zen, the awakening experience is a starting point for the rest of life, which will provide many more opportunities for further awakening experiences. In Quaker

data.author: justacrow
data.article_summary: 一项由瑞典卡罗林斯卡学院和中国多家医院及大学合作的新研究显示，基因疗法可以改善因OTOF基因突变导致的先天性耳聋或严重听力障碍患者的听力。研究对10名1至24岁的患者进行了治疗，使用合成腺相关病毒（AAV）将功能性OTOF基因注射到内耳。结果显示，所有患者在一个月内听力均有改善，六个月后平均可感知声音从106分贝降至52分贝。治疗安全且耐受良好，最常见的副作用是中性粒细胞减少。该研究为基因治疗耳聋开辟了新途径，未来有望应用于更多类型的遗传性耳聋。研究发表在《Nature Medicine》期刊上。

Published: 02-07-2025 11:00 | Updated: 02-07-2025 11:11
Gene therapy restored hearing in deaf patients
Image:
Caption:
Photo: Getty Images
Gene therapy can improve hearing in children and adults with congenital deafness or severe hearing impairment, a new study involving researchers at Karolinska Institutet reports. Hearing improved in all ten patients, and the treatment was well-tolerated. The study was conducted in collaboration with hospitals and universities in China and is published in the journal Nature Medicine.
Image:
Caption:
Maoli Duan. Photo: Ulf Sirborn
“This is a huge step forward in the genetic treatment of deafness, one that can be life-changing for children and adults,” says
Maoli Duan
, consultant and docent at the
Department of Clinical Science, Intervention and Technology
, Karolinska Institutet, Sweden, and one of the study’s corresponding authors.
The study comprised ten patients between the ages of 1 and 24 at five hospitals in China, all of whom had a genetic form of deafness or severe hearing impairment caused by mutations in a gene called OTOF. These mutations cause a deficiency of the protein otoferlin, which plays a critical part in transmitting auditory signals from the ear to the brain.
Effect within a month
The gene therapy involved using a synthetic adeno-associated virus (AAV) to deliver a functional version of the OTOF gene to the inner ear via a single injection through a membrane at the base of the cochlea called the round window.
The effect of the gene therapy was rapid and the majority of the patients recovered some hearing after just one month. A six-month follow-up showed considerable hearing improvement in all participants, the average volume of perceptible sound improving from 106 decibels to 52.
The younger patients, especially those between the ages of five and eight, responded best to the treatment. One of the participants, a seven-year-old girl, quickly recovered almost all her hearing and was able to hold daily conversations with her mother four months afterwards. However, the therapy also proved effective in adults.
“Smaller studies in China have previously shown positive results in children, but this is the first time that the method has been tested in teenagers and adults, too,” says Dr Duan. “Hearing was greatly improved in many of the participants, which can have a profound effect on their life quality. We will now be following these patients to see how lasting the effect is.”
No serious adverse reactions
The results also show that the treatment was safe and well-tolerated. The most common adverse reaction was a reduction in the number of neutrophils, a type of white blood cell. No serious adverse reactions were reported in the follow-up period of 6 to 12 months.
“OTOF is just the beginning,” says Dr Duan. “We and other researchers are expanding our work to other, more common genes that cause deafness, such as GJB2 and TMC1. These are more complicated to treat, but animal studies have so far returned promising results. We are confident that patients with different kinds of genetic deafness will one day be able to receive treatment.”
The study was conducted in collaboration with a number of institutions, including Zhongda Hospital, Southeast University, China, and was financed by several Chinese research programmes and Otovia Therapeutics Inc., the company that has developed the gene therapy and that employs many of the researchers involved in the study. See the published paper for a full list of conflicts of interest.
Publication
”AAV gene therapy for autosomal recessive deafness 9: a single-arm trial”
, Jieyu Qi, Liyan Zhang, Ling Lu, Fangzhi Tan, Cheng Cheng, Yicheng Lu, WenXiu Dong, Yinyi Zhou, Xiaolong Fu, Lulu Jiang, Chang Tan, Shanzhong Zhang, Sijie Sun, Huaien Song, Maoli Duan, Dingjun Zha, Yu Sun, Xia Gao, Lei Xu, Fan-Gang Zeng, Renjie Chai,
Nature Medicine
, online 2 July 2025, doi: 10.1038/s41591-025-03773-w.

data.title: Double is winding down
data.author: NetOpWibby
data.article_summary:
Double公司宣布将在几周内逐步停止运营，原因是客户数量不足，无法实现可持续经营。客户的资金是安全的，公司将协助将资产转移到其他券商。关键时间节点如下：

1. 7月2日起，不再接受新转入、存款或新开账户。
2. 7月30日前，自动化交易（包括清算、再平衡和税务亏损收割）将继续运行。
3. 7月31日前，客户需手动发起账户转移或清算提现。
4. 7月31日后，未关闭的账户可能需要联系Apex转移资产。

客户可通过平台发起清算并提现，或通过ACATS转移到其他券商，如M1、Wealthfront、Fidelity等。Double将承担ACATS转账费用。公司建议根据投资组合选择合适的转移目的地，并提供了相关步骤和帮助链接。对于使用定制策略的客户，推荐类似Wealthfront或Frec等平台。Double对带来的不便表示歉意，并感谢客户的支持。如有任何问题，可联系support@double.finance。

• ram_rar：对Double缺乏市场需求的原因感到好奇，是由于券商账户转移的摩擦，还是因为ETF已经满足了大多数零售投资者的需求？建议进行事后分析。
• xur17：计划将资产转移到Frec，并提到Apex之间的转移可以转移部分股份，同时提到使用推荐链接可以获得250美元的奖励。
• mizzao：作为Frec用户，从未听说过Double，担心Frec是否也会遇到同样的问题。
• languagehacker：解释Double的业务模式，并担心其客户在清算和转移过程中会遭受短期资本利得税的影响。

Double is winding down
JJ Maxwell
3 July 2025
(UTC)
Share this Article
To our clients,
I am writing to you today with some difficult news. We will be winding down the operations of Double in the coming weeks.
The simple reason is that we did not attract enough customers to be on a path towards building a sustainable business. In the world of investing, a company must ultimately stand on its own feet. Despite our best efforts, it has become clear that the demand for our particular low cost approach to automated portfolio investing is not sufficient to do so.
Your money is safe.
Our primary goal now is to ensure a smooth and orderly transition of your assets to another firm. You can initiate a cash withdrawal or transfer your assets to another brokerage. We ask that you do this by
July 31, 2025
. In the meantime, we will continue to operate as normal and trade within your account until July 31st, 2025. You can manually turn off trading if you’d like by going to
settings
and turning “Auto Trading Enabled” to False.
Here are the things to know:
Timeline
:
As of today July 2nd, 2025, we will no longer accept inbound transfers and deposits or new account creations.
Automated Trading on the platform, including Liquidations, Rebalancing and Tax Loss Harvesting, will continue until July 30th, 2025.
We ask that you please liquidate or initiate the outgoing transfer of your account by July 31st, 2025.
Any remaining accounts still open past July 31st, 2025 may require you to contact Apex to transfer your account out. We are exploring an automatic transfer program and will notify you as we approach this date.
After July 31st, 2025, the Double Website will have limited functionality.
How to Liquidate & Withdraw Cash
Create a Liquidation change
The next trading day, we will sell all your holdings.
You should be able to withdraw that cash to your Bank Account (
https://double.finance/transfer/withdraw
) the day after we sell your holdings.
Note there may be realized capital gains associated with liquidating your portfolio.
How to Initiate an ACATS Transfer
Turn off Automated Trading at Double by setting “Auto Trading Enabled” to False in Settings (
link
)
Open an account of the same type (Individual, Joint, Trust, RIA) at a similar brokerage firm like M1, Frec, Wealthfront, Betterment, Fidelity, Schwab, Robinhood, Public.
With your other brokerage, request a Transfer of all or part of your assets. Search for Apex Clearing, and find your account number on
the setting page within Double
. Please contact us prior to an outgoing ACATS and we will cover the outgoing $75 ACATS fee charged by Apex Clearing.

data.author: kris-kay
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对CSS中实现玻璃效果的设计、技术及其实现细节的评价与讨论

不同观点：
• chrismorgan认为当前效果的问题在于仅模糊了紧贴表面后的像素，尤其当背景会移动时，这个问题尤为明显。如果背景是静态的，则影响不大。
• jauntywundrkind指出该效果缺乏玻璃的折射特性，这使得视觉层次感不足。Liquid Glass的强项在于通过边缘扭曲和非线性运动来增强视觉区分，而这些在静态截图中难以体现。同时，使用SVG滤镜实现这些效果非常复杂。
• magic_hamster觉得该效果不像玻璃，因为光线与斜角没有互动，且缺少光影效果。玻璃应有自身的阴影和光学效果，而不仅仅是模糊。
• mbforbes赞赏该效果，并提到在不同浏览器间的兼容性是一个额外挑战，同时好奇哪些部分最耗资源，猜测可能是backdrop-filter。
• armchairhacker指出一个小问题：当滚动时，阴影会消失，应该初始隐藏然后淡入。
• swyx分享了一些相关资源和工具，帮助快速设计和自定义玻璃效果。
• mikedelfino发现内容在手机上滚动较慢，不确定是否是玻璃效果的副作用。
• utopcell高度赞赏该项目，特别提到米纸效果很棒。
• elpocko质疑这是否是新设计，认为与2006年的Windows Vista的Aero玻璃效果相似。
• tempodox对Video标签的实现方式感到困惑。
• jand关心是否可以复制并自行托管某些资源文件。
• arfaaan和thecosas等其他用户则对该效果表示赞赏，认为它会流行于iOS设计中。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及多个技术细节，如backdrop-filter的性能问题、阴影和光影效果的实现、以及使用SVG滤镜的复杂性。
• 部分用户如elpocko对该效果的新颖性提出质疑，认为与旧有的设计（如Windows Vista的Aero玻璃效果）相似。
• 一些用户如swyx分享了相关资源和工具，帮助其他开发者实现类似的玻璃效果。
• 用户如mikedelfino和armchairhacker关注的是用户体验方面的问题，如滚动速度和界面细节。

争议焦点：
• 玻璃效果是否应包含折射和光影效果，以增强视觉层次感和真实性。
• 该设计是否具有新颖性，或仅仅是旧有设计的重新应用。

data.title: A list is a monad
data.author: polygot
data.article_summary:
本文简要介绍了函数式编程中的单子（monad）概念，指出其解释常在抽象比喻和数学抽象之间摇摆，缺乏兼具直觉和精确的描述。单子可以被视为一种容器或上下文，保存、可能包含或不包含值；也可以视为一种延迟计算的“配方”。单子编程的核心在于编写一个函数并复用于不同上下文，而无需重写控制流逻辑。

单子分为两类：“结果”单子，如`List<int>`和`Maybe<int>`，表示已计算的值及其上下文；“配方”单子，如C#的`Task<T>`，表示尚未发生的计算。

文章通过`List`和`Maybe`示例解释了`map`和`flatMap`操作，展示了单子如何管理序列化和组合，使业务逻辑保持声明式和可组合性。与面向对象和过程式编程不同，单子将控制流委托给自己，负责如何以及何时运行函数，从而简化代码。

本文为第一部分，聚焦“结果”单子，第二部分将探讨“配方”单子如`Task`的应用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对Monad概念及其教程的讨论

不同观点：
• brooke2k认为现有的Monad教程往往让初学者更加困惑，因为它们关注的是错误的方面。Monad本身并不复杂，建议为每种常见的Monad实例（如Maybe、IO、State等）单独授课，因为每个实例的实现和应用场景都不同。同时，Monad在Haskell中的表现更为简洁。
• gr4vityWall认为“flatMappable”是对Monad最直观的描述，而数学化的描述往往难以理解。该教程比其他文章更易懂，但在结尾部分仍然变得混乱。
• nemo1618指出列表是一个数据结构，而Monad更像是一个“trait”或“interface”。列表可以实现Monad接口，但这并不是列表本身的固有属性。Haskell的列表Monad为不确定性提供了一种模型，但这是一种选择而非唯一实现方式。
• kerblang将Monad视为解决“回调地狱”的方案，通过“do comprehensions”简化嵌套回调。Monad函数可以在任何语言中实现，但在Haskell中具有更好的可读性和“扁平化”效果。
• t43562认为过多的类比和不必要的复杂描述让Monad更难以理解，强调理解Monad的用途比了解其本质更为重要。
• robinhouston指出列表不是Monad，而是List Monad的一个实例。标题的表述对数学家来说是痛苦的。
• kelseyfrog同意robinhouston的观点，建议使用更准确的表述，如“List可以被赋予一个Monad实例”。
• 1-more解释了Monad、Applicative Functor和Functor之间的关系，并通过列表和ZipList的例子说明这些概念。
• skybrian将Monad视为一种设计模式，用于构造新对象并传递回调函数，强调Monad的“bind”操作允许嵌套回调。
• drumnerd强调Monad不是容器，而是一种组合带有效果的函数的方法，定义了如何注入值和组合函数。
• ivanjermakov认为理解Monad类似于理解OOP中类和对象的区别，强调Monad接口给实现它的类型带来的好处。
• hackandthink提到Monad作为模态的另一种视角。
• mikelitoris用幽默的方式将列表比作墨西哥卷饼。
• Smaug123认为文章没有明确指出列表作为“recipe”的最自然方式，即作为有界不确定性Monad。
• nyeah以幽默的方式建议保持数学化的讨论。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于Monad的定义和描述方式，特别是如何使初学者更容易理解。不同评论者对类比、数学化描述和具体实例的作用有不同看法。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是Monad在Haskell中的实现和表现，以及与其他语言的对比。
• 评论中还涉及Monad与其他函数式编程概念（如Functor和Applicative）的关系，通过具体例子（如ZipList）进行说明。
• 一些评论者提供了对Monad的主观理解和类比，如将其视为回调函数管理器或设计模式。

for producing a value. At the heart of monadic programming is the idea that you write
one
function, say,

, and then
reuse
it across different contexts without rewriting control-flow logic.
Two Flavours: Result vs Recipe
While all monads provide a computational context, they generally fall into two flavors:
Monads as “Results”: These represent a value that has already been computed, but with extra context.
List<int>
is a result with the context.
Maybe<int>
is the result of a computation with the context of “possible optionalness.” For these, the “container” metaphor is a useful, if limited, starting point.

Task<T>

to
compute it.

List
and
Maybe

map
and
flatMap
on concrete results. In Part 2, we’ll see how these same patterns unlock immense power when applied to “recipe” monads like
Task

: Map & FlatMap in Practice

44414965.article_summary:
本文简要介绍了函数式编程中的单子（monad）概念，指出其解释常在抽象比喻和数学抽象之间摇摆，缺乏兼具直觉和精确的描述。单子可以被视为一种容器或上下文，保存、可能包含或不包含值；也可以视为一种延迟计算的“配方”。单子编程的核心在于编写一个函数并复用于不同上下文，而无需重写控制流逻辑。

单子分为两类：“结果”单子，如`List<int>`和`Maybe<int>`，表示已计算的值及其上下文；“配方”单子，如C#的`Task<T>`，表示尚未发生的计算。

文章通过`List`和`Maybe`示例解释了`map`和`flatMap`操作，展示了单子如何管理序列化和组合，使业务逻辑保持声明式和可组合性。与面向对象和过程式编程不同，单子将控制流委托给自己，负责如何以及何时运行函数，从而简化代码。

本文为第一部分，聚焦“结果”单子，第二部分将探讨“配方”单子如`Task`的应用。

data.article_summary: 文章讲述了作者对芝加哥联邦储备银行货币博物馆中一个声称装有100万美元的透明立方体展示提出质疑。通过自行计数和计算，作者发现该立方体实际包含约155.04万美元，比标示的多出55.04万美元。作者开发了一个名为"Dot Counter"的工具来辅助计数，并探讨了多种可能的原因，包括数学误差、通货膨胀以及美元钞票不适合立方体堆叠等。文章最后幽默地指出，这个立方体不仅包含了100万美元，还多出了“额外奖金”。

争议焦点：立方体的实际金额是否如展示所声称的为100万美元，以及内部是否存在填充物或空隙。

data.title: ICEBlock climbs to the top of the App Store charts after officials slam it
data.author: doener
data.article_summary: 美国政府官员谴责了ICEBlock应用及其媒体报道，这反而使其下载量大增，现已成为苹果App Store中排名第一的免费社交网络应用。ICEBlock由Joshua Aaron开发，旨在让用户在地图上标记ICE特工出现的位置，并添加备注，如特工的衣着或车辆。当用户靠近标记地点时，会收到提醒。白宫发言人Karoline Leavitt认为该应用可能煽动对ICE官员的暴力，ICE代理局长Todd M. Lyons则表示该应用将特工置于危险之中。美国国土安全部长Kristi Noem和司法部长Pam Bondi表示将追究Aaron的法律责任，但他强调ICEBlock不收集个人数据，且仅在iOS上可用以保护用户隐私。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于一款帮助用户避开警察活动的应用程序（ICEBlock）的争议

不同观点：
• 一些用户（如neither_color）支持使用此类应用，认为这与违法行为无关，而是为了避免不必要的麻烦，如DUI检查点或交通堵塞。该用户特别提到，作为肤色较深的守法公民，不希望在非机场场所被要求出示证件并接受盘问。

• 其他用户（如datax2）将该应用与Waze、闪灯提醒等行为相提并论，认为这些都是言论自由的一部分，且在多次法庭裁决中获得支持。同时，批评某些极端言论威胁执法人员生命安全的说法。

• 一些评论（如abeppu）批评对CNN等媒体报道该应用的攻擊，认为报道或讨论如何报告警察活动本身不应被视为问题。并质疑如果讨论此类应用的文章被广泛关注，是否也意味着媒体在危害执法人员生命。

• 技术实现和平台选择成为讨论重点。一些用户（如callahad和loughy）提到苹果曾拒绝上架涉及政治敏感内容的应用，但对ICEBlock却允许上架，并讨论了在Android平台上因隐私和法律问题未能上架的情况。

• 社会经济问题也被提及（如apparent和wnevets），有用户质疑使用iOS设备的群体是否与担忧被移民执法人员拦截的群体重合，并提出是否有必要将资源用于此类应用而不是其他公共服务（如飓风卫星数据）。

• 国际对比和政治观点（如nottorp和Vektorceraptor）提到类似应用在其他国家（如伊朗）的存在，并讨论了关于移民和公共安全的意识形态分歧。

补充讨论：
• 一些用户（如ramoz和mandevil）提到该应用因对抗性策略而受到关注，并引用“Streisand效应”说明试图压制信息往往适得其反，增加了信息的传播。

• 也有用户（如SomeHacker44）分享了与执法人员正面互动的个人经历，提醒大家不要一概而论所有政府工作人员，但同时也认为应谨慎减少不必要的互动。

争议焦点：该应用是否构成对执法人员的威胁，及其在言论自由和隐私保护之间的平衡。此外，应用的平台选择和技术实现也引发了讨论。

44445180.article_content:
Read full article
mariella moon
Contributing Reporter
Tue, Jul 1, 2025, 7:43 PM
·
2 min read
0
Mario Tama via Getty Images
US government officials have condemned ICEBlock and
CNN's
recent
coverage
of it, leading to more people hearing about its existence and downloading it from the App Store. Now the application, which allows users to add a pin on a map to show where ICE agents have recently been spotted, has
climbed
to the to the top of Apple's App Store charts. It's currently the number one free social networking app in the US and the third most downloaded free app overall.
Engadget
CNN's
piece talked about how the app's developer, Joshua Aaron, launched it in early April after seeing the Trump administration crack down on immigration. When the piece went live, Aaron said the app had 20,000 users, many of whom live in Los Angeles, where ICE has been raiding neighborhoods. In addition to letting users pin ICE agent locations on a map, the app also gives them a way to add notes, such as what the agents are wearing or what car they're driving. Any user within a five mile radius of the sighting will get an alert.
But White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt
suggested
that the
CNN
piece was "an incitement of further violence against... ICE officers" when asked to respond to the report on the podium. She said that there's been a 500 percent increase against ICE agents who are just "trying to do their jobs and remove public safety threats from... communities." ICE acting Director Todd M. Lyons also
issued a statement
, saying that the app paints a target on federal law enforcement officers' backs. "
CNN
is willfully endangering the lives of officers who put their lives on the line every day and enabling dangerous criminal aliens to evade US law," he continued. "Is this simply reckless 'journalism' or overt activism?"
ADVERTISEMENT
Advertisement
Meanwhile, US Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem and US Attorney General Pam Bondi both said the government is going after Aaron. "He's giving a message to criminals where our federal officers are,"
Bondi said
. "...we are looking at it, we are looking at him, and he better watch out, because that's not a protected speech. That is threatening the lives of our law enforcement officers throughout this country."'
Aaron told
CNN
that ICEBlock doesn't collect personal data, such as device IDs and IP addresses, which
TechCrunch
has confirmed in a test. The app is only available on iOS, because it would have to collect information on Android that could put people at risk.

data.title: Content Independence Day: no AI crawl without compensation
data.author: kotk
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了互联网内容创作和AI技术之间的变化与挑战。谷歌等搜索引擎过去通过引流为内容创作者提供价值，但随着AI工具（如ChatGPT）的兴起，用户逐渐转向AI获取答案，导致内容创作者获得的流量和收益大幅减少。文章宣布2025年7月1日为“内容独立日”，Cloudflare与多家主要出版商和AI公司合作，默认阻止未付费的AI爬虫抓取内容，确保创作者获得补偿。未来还将建立一个市场，根据内容对AI引擎的知识贡献而非流量来评估其价值，旨在促进高质量内容创作和AI发展。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何应对AI爬虫对网站带来的负担，以及Cloudflare等技术的有效性和公平性。

不同观点：
• agentultra：认为Cloudflare等技术是缓解AI公司给网站带来的负担的一种尝试，但对仅依赖Cloudflare的善意持谨慎态度。同时指出，使用蜜罐和陷阱来阻止AI爬虫是无奈之举，且影响了网站运营的价值。
• TekMol：分享了自己通过封锁请求大量URL的IP范围的方法，尽管这种方法可能封锁整个国家的IP段，但至少能保证服务运行。
• azangru：对Cloudflare如何技术性地阻止AI爬虫表示好奇，询问是通过用户代理检查还是IP范围封锁。
• rorylaitila：认为阻止AI爬虫的努力可能已经来不及，建议客户转向社区互动内容，而非信息性内容，以应对AI的冲击。
• mhuffman：质疑AI公司是否会尊重robots.txt文件，尤其是这些公司曾未经允许使用信息来训练模型。
• yladiz：提出Anubis是否比Cloudflare更优的疑问。
• mzs：好奇Cloudflare是否从中获取利益，或者这是否在保密协议之下。
• jmole：赞同AI引擎对原创内容的需求理论，但指出AI数据生成产业对知识生态的破坏更大，特别提到公司如pareto.ai。
• ChrisArchitect：提供了一个讨论链接，进一步讨论Cloudflare对AI爬虫的收费措施。
• tiahura：质疑网络是否应保持自由和开放，提出对封锁措施的反对。
• ramesh31：认为这种做法会像“do not track”头信息一样无效，坏人会引发军备竞赛，使得遵守规则的人吃亏。
• accountforih：指出付费爬虫服务如brightdata或crawlbase已经存在，封锁措施最终伤害的是无害的小公司和个人。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于技术封锁的有效性和公平性，以及是否会导致新的不公平竞争环境。
- 讨论还涉及对原创内容价值的重新评估，以及如何在AI时代调整内容策略。
- 对Cloudflare商业模式的质疑和对其技术实现细节的探讨也是讨论的重要组成部分。

44445297.article_content:
Content Independence Day: no AI crawl without compensation!
2025-07-01
Matthew Prince
4 min read
Almost 30 years ago, two graduate students at Stanford University â Larry Page and Sergey Brin â began working on a research project they called Backrub. That, of course, was the project that resulted in Google. But also something more: it created the business model for the web.
The deal that Google made with content creators was simple: let us copy your content for search, and we'll send you traffic. You, as a content creator, could then derive value from that traffic in one of three ways: running ads against it, selling subscriptions for it, or just getting the pleasure of knowing that someone was consuming your stuff.
Google facilitated all of this. Search generated traffic. They acquired DoubleClick and built AdSense to help content creators serve ads. And acquired Urchin to launch Google Analytics to let you measure just who was viewing your content at any given moment in time.
For nearly thirty years, that relationship was what defined the web and allowed it to flourish.
But that relationship is changing. For the first time in its history, the number of searches run on Google is declining. What's taking its place? AI.
If you're like me, you've been amazed at the new AI systems that have launched over the last two years and find yourself turning to them to answer questions that, in the past, you may have previously looked to Google. While it's still early, it seems clear that the interface of the future of the web will look more like ChatGPT than a spartan search box and ten blue links.
Google itself has changed. While ten years ago they presented a list of links and said that success was getting you off their site as quickly as possible, today they've added an answer box and more recently AI Overviews which answer users' questions without them having to leave Google.com. With the answer box they reported that 75 percent of queries were answered without users leaving Google. With the more recent launch of AI Overviews it's even higher.
While Googleâs users may like that, it's hurting content creators. Google still copies creatorsâ content, but over the last 10 years, because of the changes to the UI of âsearchâ it's gotten almost 10 times more difficult for a content creator to get the same volume of traffic. That means it's 10 times more difficult to generate value from ads, subscriptions, or the ego of knowing someone cares about what you created.
And that's the good news. Itâs even worse with
todayâs AI tools
. With OpenAI, it's 750 times more difficult to get traffic than it was with the Google of old. With Anthropic, it's 30,000 times more difficult. The reason is simple: increasingly we aren't consuming originals, we're consuming derivatives.
The problem is whether you create content to sell ads, sell subscriptions, or just to know that people value what you've created, an AI-driven web doesn't reward content creators the way that the old search-driven web did. And that means the deal that Google made to take content in exchange for sending you traffic just doesn't make sense anymore.
Instead of being a fair trade, the web is being stripmined by AI crawlers with content creators seeing almost no traffic and therefore almost no value.
That changes today, July 1, what weâre calling Content Independence Day. Cloudflare, along with a majority of the world's leading publishers and AI companies, is changing the default to block AI crawlers unless they pay creators for their content. That content is the fuel that powers AI engines, and so it's only fair that content creators are compensated directly for it.
But that's just the beginning. Next, we'll work on a marketplace where content creators and AI companies, large and small, can come together. Traffic was always a poor proxy for value. We think we can do better. Let me explain.
Imagine an AI engine like a block of swiss cheese. New, original content that fills one of the holes in the AI engineâs block of cheese is more valuable than repetitive, low-value content that unfortunately dominates much of the web today.
We believe that if we can begin to score and value content not on how much traffic it generates, but on how much it furthers knowledge âÂ measured by how much it fills the current holes in AI engines âswiss cheeseâ â we not only will help AI engines get better faster, but also potentially facilitate a new golden age of high-value content creation.
We donât know all the answers yet, but weâre working with some of the leading economists and computer scientists to figure them out.
The web is changing. Its business model will change. And, in the process, we have an opportunity to learn from what was great about the web of the last 30 years and what we can make better for the web of the future.
Cloudflare's mission is to help build a better Internet. I'm proud of the role we're playing in doing exactly that as the web e

data.title: Firefox 120 to Firefox 141 Web Browser Benchmarks
data.author: mikece
data.article_summary: 本文由Michael Larabel撰写，比较了从2023年11月的Firefox 120到最新的Firefox 140稳定版及141测试版的性能。所有测试在同一台运行Ubuntu Linux系统的AMD Ryzen 9 9950X处理器设备上进行，评估了浏览器的性能和内存使用情况。由于Firefox 119及之前版本在自动化测试中遇到问题，测试从Firefox 120开始。每个主要版本都进行了多种基准测试，并监测了内存使用情况。测试使用的是Ubuntu 25.04系统，以确保一致性。结果展示了Firefox在过去近两年中的性能变化。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：浏览器的性能、功能、用户体验及相关问题

不同观点：
• **支持Firefox**：
   - **saubeidl**：Firefox表现不错，Mozilla不像Google那样“邪恶”，浏览器垄断对任何人都没有好处。Firefox继续支持Manifest v2，uBlock等插件能正常工作，是切换浏览器的好时机。
   - **cadamsdotcom**：Firefox非常优秀，特别是在Mac上，支持adblock且有助于防止浏览器单一化。
   - **alberth**：浏览器之间的电池寿命差异也不再显著，Firefox表现均衡。

• **浏览器性能讨论**：
   - **em500**：尽管浏览器和硬件速度变快，但实际使用中由于复杂的网页框架、认证墙和广告，用户体验并没有显著提升，符合Wirth定律和Jevons悖论。
   - **Night_Thastus**：现代PC上浏览器性能差异不大，瓶颈往往是网页而不是浏览器。移动端浏览器的体验较差，尤其是面对广告和慢速网站。
   - **Milpotel**：慢速主要源于网站和网络连接，而非浏览器本身。

• **浏览器体验问题**：
   - **butz**：安装广告拦截器是提升网页性能的最佳方法。
   - **blinding-streak**：引用测试数据，Firefox 141 Beta比120版本快12%。

• **Firefox的缺陷与批评**：
   - **taf2**：除非Mozilla解决某些长期存在的问题，否则不接受Firefox，认为其已经失去原有价值。
   - **amendegree**：批评Firefox的更新过程繁琐，需要手动确认UAC提示且中断当前浏览。

补充讨论：

For those curious about the direction of Mozilla Firefox web browser performance over the past year and a half, here are web browser benchmarks for every Firefox release from Firefox 120 in November 2023 through the newest Firefox 140 stable and Firefox 140 beta releases from a few days ago. Every major Firefox release was benchmarked on the same Ubuntu Linux system with AMD Ryzen 9 9950X for evaluating the performance and memory usage of this open-source web browser.
Following the recent
Firefox 141 beta benchmarks looking at the lower RAM usage
on Linux, I got carried away and decided to benchmark every Firefox release going back to Firefox 120 that debuted in November of 2023. Firefox 120 was the breaking point since Firefox 119 and prior ended up running into issues with Selenium / Gecko web driver for automating the benchmarks. So due to that breakage, Firefox 120 was the old cut-off but still a useful exercise in seeing the performance of Firefox on Linux over roughly the past nearly two years.
The release builds of every major Firefox release from Firefox 120 through Firefox 141 Beta were tested. In the case of Firefox 125, Firefox 125.0.1 was used since Firefox 125.0 binaries were removed due to problems. In addition to looking at the Firefox performance across a variety of web browser benchmarks, the RAM usage was also monitored for reference.
The same AMD Ryzen 9 9950X desktop system running Ubuntu 25.04 was used for collecting all of these fresh Mozilla Firefox web browser benchmarks. The testing is very straight-forward so let's get right to it.

data.title: Stop Killing Games
data.author: MYEUHD
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：视频游戏软件的终止支持及其对消费者的影响，如何立法规范以保障消费者权益，以及该问题是否仅限于游戏行业。

不同观点：
• **支持对消费者保护的立法**：andrecarini认为需要立法来防止消费者在购买软件后因服务终止而受损，并提出了几种可能的解决方案，如设置软件到期日、公开服务器源代码或允许反向工程。icu和butlike等用户也支持这种立法，认为需要对消费者提供更多保护，并强调行业内存在许多不利于消费者的行为。

• **质疑立法如何执行**：Apreche和jasonthness对立法的可行性提出质疑。Apreche指出，如果公司破产，无法强制其维持服务器运行，且强制公开代码可能涉及其他知识产权问题。jasonthness认为法律无法凭空产生资金或维持运营的意愿，并担心法规会伤害独立开发者。

• **对多玩家游戏的特殊性存在争议**：hombre_fatal和royal__讨论了多玩家游戏的特殊性。hombre_fatal认为多玩家游戏在何时应退款的问题上不明确，且与单人游戏不同。royal__指出，无法预测游戏的长远成功，服务器成本是主要问题，尤其是在MMOs中。

• **现有解决方案的实例**：VonGuard提到在美国已有通过DMCA豁免允许单人游戏在服务器关闭后继续运行的案例，展示了现有的一些法律途径。ortusdux提供了ACEmulator作为MMORPGs的社区支持解决方案实例。

• **对整个软件行业的扩展讨论**：arandomhuman认为该问题不仅限于游戏行业，而是广泛存在于一次性购买的软件许可模型中，主张软件供应商应对产品终止支持负有责任。

补充讨论：
• **DRM和社区解决方案**：lousken强调使用无DRM和具备专用服务器/局域网选项的重要性。
• **立法对创新的潜在影响**：Derelicte提到像《Pokémon Go》这样的游戏可能无法在强制立法下诞生，暗示立法可能抑制创新。

总体来看，讨论围绕消费者保护、立法可行性、多玩家游戏的特殊性以及现有和潜在解决方案展开。争议焦点在于如何在保护消费者权益和不损害开发者利益之间取得平衡。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：多个科技公司发布的招聘信息及其对候选人的要求

不同观点：
• Estuary强调其开放源代码和开发者优先的文化，专注于实时数据基础设施，寻找具有后端工程经验并能处理复杂API和数据库集成的工程师。
• kierangill介绍Blueberry Pediatrics的使命——通过提供负担得起的、高质量的小儿远程医疗服务来改变美国医疗保健。他们寻找全栈工程师，重视全栈知识、好奇心和强大的工作 ethic。
• camperegrine展示Peregrine Technologies的工程团队，帮助关键机构通过解锁数据价值来改善运营。他们正在寻找具有丰富经验的高级软件工程师，尤其是在AI和基础设施方面。
• katyborrowell描述Borrowell作为加拿大金融科技公司的领先地位，正在寻找开发人员加入其团队，强调多样性、包容性和创新文化。
• manish_gill介绍ClickHouse的招聘需求，特别是云基础设施和Kubernetes方面的专业知识，要求候选人具备独立和自组织的能力。
• mstubna介绍Hackensack Meridian Health的招聘信息，寻找高级软件工程师和数据科学家，帮助构建数据管道和AI解决方案。

补充讨论：
• 各公司对技术栈有不同的偏好，例如Estuary偏好Go和Rust，Blueberry Pediatrics使用Django和Flutter，Peregrine Technologies使用React和Kafka，Borrowell偏好全栈开发和测试自动化。
• 工作地点和形式多样，包括远程工作（如Estuary、Blueberry Pediatrics、Borrowell）、混合模式（如Peregrine Technologies、Coveo）以及特定地点要求（如Calico在波士顿，MONUMENTAL在阿姆斯特丹）。
• 对候选人的期望不仅限于技术能力，还包括沟通能力、团队合作、自主性和创新精神（如Goody、Coveo、Peregrine Technologies）。
• 某些公司强调其初创环境和快速发展机会，如Estuary、Goody、Yottar和Monumental，这些公司提供高自主性和股权激励。

争议焦点：
• 不同公司对远程工作的接受程度以及对技术栈的偏好可能成为候选人选择公司的争议点。例如，一些公司完全接受远程工作（如Estuary、Blueberry Pediatrics），而另一些公司则更倾向于混合模式（如Peregrine Technologies、Coveo）。
• 对于某些角色，如AI工程师和云架构师，不同公司提供的薪酬范围和股权激励可能成为吸引候选人的竞争点。

总结：
上述评论展示了多家科技公司在招聘高级软件工程师和其他相关职位时的不同要求和公司文化。这些公司不仅关注技术能力，还重视候选人的沟通能力、团队合作和自主创新精神，提供了多样化的工作地点和形式选择。

data.title: Three Ubisoft chiefs found guilty of enabling culture of sexual harassment
data.author: freddier
data.article_summary: Ubisoft三名高管被判建立并助长职场性骚扰和心理骚扰文化，其中包括公司前创意总监Serge Hascoët。法院发现Hascoët犯有心理骚扰和共谋性骚扰罪，被判18个月缓刑及罚款€45,000。另一名前高管Thomas François被判性骚扰、心理骚扰及 attempted sexual assault，获三年缓刑及罚款€30,000。前游戏总监Guillaume Patrux也被判心理骚扰，获12个月缓刑及罚款€10,000。证词显示，Ubisoft巴黎办公室在2012至2020年间存在严重的性别歧视和不当行为，被形容为“法外男士俱乐部”。此案被视为游戏行业#MeToo运动的重要转折点。Hascoët考虑上诉。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对涉及性骚扰和虐待事件的报道和标题的准确性及其背后的历史背景。

不同观点：
• [mmonaghan] 认为文章的标题不够准确，建议标题应更直接地反映事件的严重性。他强调，这不仅仅是“男孩间的胡闹”，而是实际的虐待行为，读者应该通过阅读文章来了解事件的严重性。

• [burnt-resistor] 则提到了类似事件在历史上未被曝光的现象，特别是Sun Microsystems在过去几十年中的严重虐待行为未被公开报道，暗示这类问题长期存在但未得到应有的关注。

补充讨论：
• [mmonaghan] 强调事件的严重性，并认为媒体有责任通过准确的标题来传达这种严重性。

• [burnt-resistor] 提到了历史上的类似事件，指出社会和媒体在过去对这类问题的忽视，暗示当前的报道可能是一种进步，但也反映出过去的不公正。

争议的焦点：
• 标题的准确性和媒体责任：[mmonaghan] 认为当前标题未能反映事件的严重性，而 [burnt-resistor] 则关注历史上类似事件未被曝光的现象。

• 事件严重性的认知：[mmonaghan] 明确指出这是实际的虐待行为，而非简单的“男孩间的胡闹”，而 [burnt-resistor] 的评论则暗示了这种行为在历史上长期被忽视的问题。

Ubisoft
Three Ubisoft chiefs found guilty of enabling culture of sexual harassment
Former staff likened offices of video game company in Paris to a ‘boys’ club above the law’
Angelique Chrisafis
in Paris
Wed 2 Jul 2025 11.12 EDT
First published on Wed 2 Jul 2025 11.11 EDT
Share
Three former executives at the video game company
Ubisoft
have been given suspended prison sentences for enabling a culture of sexual and psychological harassment in the workplace at the end of the
first big trial
to stem from the
#MeToo movement
in the gaming industry.
The court in Bobigny, north of Paris, had heard how the former executives used their position to bully or sexually harass staff,
leaving women terrified
and feeling like pieces of meat.
Former staff had said that between 2012 and 2020, the company’s offices in Montreuil, east of
Paris
, were run with a toxic culture of bullying and sexism that one worker likened to a “boys’ club above the law”.
Former bosses at video games firm Ubisoft on trial in France accused of sexual harassment
Read more
Ubisoft is a French family business that rose to become one of the biggest video game creators in the world. The company has been behind several blockbusters including
Assassin’s Creed
,
Far Cry
and the children’s favourite
Just Dance
.
The state prosecutor, Antoine Haushalter, had told the court the world of video games and its subculture had an element of “systemic” sexism and potential abuse and called the trial a “turning point” for the gaming world.
Thomas François, 52, a former
Ubisoft
editorial vice-president, was found guilty of sexual harassment, psychological harassment and an attempted sexual assault. He was given a three-year suspended prison sentence and fined €30,000 (£26,000).
The court heard how he once tied a female member of staff to a chair with tape, pushed the chair into a lift and pressed a button at random. He was also accused of forcing one woman wearing a skirt to do handstands.
She told the court: “He was my superior and I was afraid of him. He made me do handstands. I did it to get it over with and get rid of him.”
View image in fullscreen
Thomas François, a former Ubisoft editorial vice-president, was found guilty of sexual harassment, psychological harassment and an attempted sexual assault.
Photograph: Xavier Galiana/AFP/Getty
At a 2015 office Christmas party with a Back to the Future theme, François allegedly told a member of staff that he liked her 1950s dress. He then allegedly stepped towards her to kiss her on the mouth as his colleagues restrained her by the arms and back. She shouted and broke free.
François had told the court there was a “culture of joking around”. He said: “I never tried to harm anyone.”

data.title: Automatically Rewrite Container Image References in Kubernetes
data.author: flemzord
data.article_summary:
**Mutating Registry Webhook** 是一个 Kubernetes 可变准入 Webhook，用于自动重写容器镜像引用，使其使用缓存注册表（如 AWS ECR Pull Through Cache）。它支持基于正则表达式和命名空间/标签的重写规则，适用于将镜像从 Docker Hub、GCR、Quay.io 等重定向到内部注册表。该项目具有高性能、安全性（通过 cert-manager 集成）、Prometheus 指标支持和 Helm 图表部署等特性。

**快速开始**：
1. 安装 cert-manager。
2. 使用 `kubectl apply` 安装 Webhook。
3. 创建 `RegistryRewriteRule` 自定义资源以定义重写规则。
4. 构建并推送镜像，部署到集群。

项目提供 YAML 文件和 Helm 图表两种部署方式，便于用户安装和分发。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：在Kubernetes和容器运行环境中处理镜像注册的地址重写方案，特别是在内部网络或隔离环境（air-gapped environments）中的应用。

不同观点：
• [sscarduzio] 认为可以在内部网络中运行注册表并使用重写规则，帮助解决隔离环境中的镜像获取问题。不过，他询问是否存在潜在的“陷阱”或问题。

• [remram] 提出另一种思路，建议将重写规则直接构建到容器运行时的配置中，而不是仅仅依赖自动重写。他认为即使自动重写了镜像地址，但在通过API服务器读取时，重写后的镜像仍然可见，这可能不是理想的方案。

• [flemzord] 分享了自己的实际经验，表示已经开发了一个Kubernetes的Mutating Admission Webhook，可以在Pod创建和更新时自动根据配置规则重写镜像引用。这种方法可以有效地将公共注册表的镜像重定向到内部镜像或缓存，从而提高安全性和可靠性。

• [nonameiguess] 则指出可以使用containerd的注册表镜像功能来实现相同的效果，并且重写规则的语法是一样的，认为没有必要额外开发其他工具或配置。

补充讨论：
- 讨论的焦点在于如何有效地处理隔离环境中的镜像重写问题，特别是在Kubernetes集群中。
- [remram] 对自动重写方案提出质疑，认为在API服务器层仍能看到重写后的镜像，可能存在安全隐患。
- [flemzord] 提供了具体的实践经验，强调了使用Webhook的解决方案，可以提升安全性和可靠性。
- [nonameiguess] 则认为使用现有的containerd功能已经足够，无需额外开发。

争议焦点：是否需要开发额外的工具（如Webhook）来进行镜像重写，还是利用现有的容器运行时配置或注册表镜像功能即可满足需求。
